title: Offline Reinforcement Learning via High-Fidelity Generative Behavior Modeling

methods.one_paragraph_description: Learn a diffusion (score-based) model of the behavior policy mu(a|s) and an action-evaluation critic Q trained by in-sample planning (K value iterations). At runtime draw M=32 action candidates from the diffusion behavior model, score them with Q, and select from candidates (deterministic at eval: highest-Q action; on locomotion, average of the 4 highest-Q candidates).
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL (generative behavior modeling; 'policy regression'/in-sample learning: 'Both IQL and SfBC aim to entirely avoid selecting out-of-sample actions')

diffusion_steps_D.quote: We use a diffusion step of D = 15 for all reported results in Table 1, which is significantly less than

ode_solver.quote: To draw action samples from the behavior model, we use a 3rd-order specialized diffusion ODE solver proposed by Lu et al. (2022) to solve the inverse ODE problem in Equation 6.

candidate_number_M.quote: We set the candidate number M to 32 in all experiments.

action_selection.value: average of the 4 highest-Q actions among M candidates (locomotion)
action_selection.quote: In MuJoCo Locomotion tasks, we average four actions with the highest Q-values among all candidates and find this technique helps to stabilize performance.

value_iterations_K.quote: We use K = 2 value iterations for all MuJoCo tasks, K = 4 for Antmaze-umaze tasks, and K = 5 for other Antmaze tasks.

inverse_temperature_alpha.quote: with the inverse temperature α set to 20 and the Monte Carlo sample number set to 16 in all tasks.

monte_carlo_samples.quote: with the inverse temperature α set to 20 and the Monte Carlo sample number set to 16 in all tasks.

behavior_batch_size.quote: Behavior training. In all experiments, we use the Adam optimizer and a batch size of 4096.

behavior_epochs.quote: conditional scored-based model is trained for 500 data epochs with a learning rate of 1e-4.

behavior_learning_rate.quote: conditional scored-based model is trained for 500 data epochs with a learning rate of 1e-4.

sde.quote: we set β(t) = (βmax − βmin ) t + βmin , with βmin being 0.1 and βmax being 20.

critic_epochs_per_iteration.quote: The action evaluation model is trained for 100 data epochs with a learning rate of 1e-3 for each value iteration.

critic_learning_rate.quote: The action evaluation model is trained for 100 data epochs with a learning rate of 1e-3 for each value iteration.

critic_architecture.quote: For the action evaluation model, we use a 2-layer MLP with 256 hidden units and SiLU activation functions.

behavior_architecture.quote: The architecture of the behavior model resembles U-Nets, but with spatial convolutions changed to simple dense connections, inspired by Janner et al. (2022).

target_networks_ensembles.quote: we do not use either ensembled networks or target networks to stabilize Q-learning.

evaluation_protocol.episodes_per_seed: 20 test seeds (locomotion), evaluated every 5 data epochs
evaluation_protocol.checkpoint_selection: not explicitly stated (performance averaged 'at regular intervals (5 data epochs)')
evaluation_protocol.quote: we run all Antmaze and MuJoCo experiments over 4 trials (different random seeds) and other experiments over 3 trials. For each trial, performance is averaged on another 100 test seeds for Antmaze tasks and 20 test seeds for other tasks at regular intervals (5 data epochs).
